verdict.rationale: Kick's docs say it sets up a standard Chart of Accounts that you or your accountant can adjust by adding, renaming, or restructuring accounts, and the plan table lists "classes" as a Plus-tier feature. That covers basic CoA customization and suggests a class dimension exists, but the rest of the story is not documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of account types, sub-account/parent-child hierarchy, how classes or tags are configured and applied, any tag dimension beyond classes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
